name: Demon Dash
source:
Somehow the world got taken over by demons because everyone was too gay. Despite the new demon overlords being a bit dangerous, most of them are just vibing and most humans got to continue their lives unaffected.  After the general consensus came out that there was a niche for those who REALLY liked demons, a dating and delivery app called demon dash was invented where people can sign up to be a lucky candidate to be picked up by a demon girl. 

[From [url=https://nadianova.itch.io/demon-dash]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
不知怎的，全世界都被恶魔接管了，原因竟是大家都太弯了。虽然新上任的恶魔统治者有些危险，但大多数只是自在地过日子，人类生活也基本未受影响。后来人们普遍发现，有一群人特别喜欢恶魔，于是“Demon Dash”约会与配送App应运而生：人们可以报名成为幸运候选者，被恶魔女孩选中并接走。

[摘自[url=https://nadianova.itch.io/demon-dash]Itch.io[/url]]
